postgresql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_auth_event (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR, 
	username VARCHAR(120), 
	event VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_login_limit (
	bucket VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	window_start INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (bucket)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_user (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	active INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	password_changed_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (username)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_probe (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR, 
	url TEXT, 
	checked_at VARCHAR, 
	status_code INTEGER, 
	duration_ms INTEGER, 
	ok INTEGER, 
	details JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS battery_availability_forecast (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR, 
	created_at VARCHAR, 
	confidence VARCHAR, 
	parameters JSON, 
	result JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS candidato_tecnico (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	release VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	brand VARCHAR, 
	model VARCHAR, 
	year INTEGER, 
	raw JSON NOT NULL, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	collected_at VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emplacamento_mensal (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	brand VARCHAR, 
	model VARCHAR, 
	propulsion VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (reference, provider, brand, model, propulsion)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS etl_execucao (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR, 
	started_at VARCHAR, 
	finished_at VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR, 
	stage VARCHAR, 
	raw_rows INTEGER, 
	bev_rows INTEGER, 
	matched_rows INTEGER, 
	error TEXT, 
	details JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fonte_dado (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	url TEXT, 
	kind VARCHAR, 
	collected_at VARCHAR, 
	reference VARCHAR, 
	details JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS frota_combustivel (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	uf VARCHAR, 
	city VARCHAR, 
	fuel_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	propulsion VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (reference, uf, city, fuel_type)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intelligence_audit (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR, 
	role VARCHAR, 
	action VARCHAR, 
	entity_type VARCHAR, 
	entity_id VARCHAR, 
	created_at VARCHAR, 
	details JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS localidade (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	uf VARCHAR, 
	city VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalized VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS match_modelo (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	raw_name VARCHAR, 
	vehicle_year INTEGER, 
	model_id VARCHAR, 
	score FLOAT, 
	method VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR, 
	approver VARCHAR, 
	notes TEXT, 
	created_at VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS modelo_nao_classificado (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	raw_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicles INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	electrified_hint INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (reference, raw_name)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS modelo_veiculo (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	brand VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	year_start INTEGER, 
	year_end INTEGER, 
	classification_source TEXT, 
	aliases JSON, 
	category VARCHAR, 
	propulsion VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS passport_schema_version (
	version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	fields JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_alert_policy (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	values JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_artifact (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	dataset VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	raw_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	parser_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalization_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	url TEXT, 
	collected_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	uncompressed_bytes BIGINT, 
	rows BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	semantic_content_id VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (provider, dataset, reference, raw_sha256, parser_version, normalization_version)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_epoch (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	value VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_job (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	stage VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	available_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR, 
	lease_until VARCHAR, 
	token INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	epoch VARCHAR, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER, 
	error TEXT, 
	result JSON, 
	progress JSON NOT NULL, 
	block_size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_publication_intent (
	reference VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (reference)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_rule (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	raw_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR, 
	model VARCHAR, 
	powertrain VARCHAR, 
	category VARCHAR, 
	decision VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	evidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (raw_name, version)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_alert_policy (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	national_pct INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	model_pct INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	model_absolute INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_alias (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	namespace VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	old_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	canonical_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (entity_type, namespace, old_id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_command (
	key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	body_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	result JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_identifier (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entity_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	issuer VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalized VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	evidence VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_model (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_category VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	powertrain_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	allocated_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (model_key)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_setting (
	key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	value JSON NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scheduler_tick (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	started_at VARCHAR, 
	finished_at VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR, 
	error VARCHAR, 
	run_id VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_snapshot (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR, 
	dataset_name VARCHAR, 
	reference_period VARCHAR, 
	retrieved_at VARCHAR, 
	method VARCHAR, 
	raw_file_hash VARCHAR, 
	raw_storage_path VARCHAR, 
	source_version VARCHAR, 
	transformation_version VARCHAR, 
	license_or_terms VARCHAR, 
	ingestion_status VARCHAR, 
	source_url VARCHAR, 
	scope VARCHAR, 
	metric VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	record_count INTEGER, 
	access_level VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	metadata JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (provider, dataset_name, reference_period, raw_file_hash)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS uf_populacao (
	uf VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	population INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	year INTEGER, 
	source TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uf)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_session (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	csrf_token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES admin_user (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bateria (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	capacity_kwh FLOAT, 
	usable_kwh FLOAT, 
	chemistry VARCHAR, 
	technology VARCHAR, 
	voltage FLOAT, 
	pack_manufacturer VARCHAR, 
	part_number VARCHAR, 
	warranty_years INTEGER, 
	warranty_km INTEGER, 
	warranty_notes TEXT, 
	provenance JSON NOT NULL, 
	confidence VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (capacity_kwh > 0 AND capacity_kwh <= 500), 
	FOREIGN KEY(model_id) REFERENCES modelo_veiculo (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS battery_model (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR, 
	model_name VARCHAR, 
	chemistry VARCHAR, 
	technology VARCHAR, 
	part_number VARCHAR, 
	confidence VARCHAR, 
	nominal_capacity_kwh FLOAT, 
	usable_capacity_kwh FLOAT, 
	nominal_voltage_v FLOAT, 
	min_voltage_v FLOAT, 
	max_voltage_v FLOAT, 
	rated_capacity_ah FLOAT, 
	expected_cycle_life FLOAT, 
	automotive_eol_threshold_percent FLOAT, 
	warranty_years FLOAT, 
	warranty_km FLOAT, 
	module_count INTEGER, 
	cell_count INTEGER, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	field_sources JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fleet_publication (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reference_period VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR, 
	stage VARCHAR, 
	started_at VARCHAR, 
	finished_at VARCHAR, 
	error VARCHAR, 
	planned_units INTEGER, 
	materialized_units INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (source_snapshot_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS passport_dossier (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	schema_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	values JSON NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (owner_type, owner_id), 
	CHECK (owner_type IN ('vehicle','battery')), 
	UNIQUE (code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(schema_version) REFERENCES passport_schema_version (version)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_attempt (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	token INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	epoch VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	started_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	finished_at VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	error TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (job_id, number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES pipeline_job (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_block (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	stage VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	block_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	result JSON NOT NULL, 
	finished_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (job_id, stage, block_index), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES pipeline_job (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_content (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	dataset VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalization_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	semantic_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	rows BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (provider, dataset, reference, normalization_version, semantic_sha256), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES pipeline_artifact (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_observation (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ordinal BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	member TEXT NOT NULL, 
	line_number BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	canonical TEXT NOT NULL, 
	row_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR, 
	city VARCHAR, 
	raw_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	manufacture_year INTEGER, 
	category VARCHAR, 
	quantity BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (artifact_id, ordinal), 
	CHECK (quantity >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES pipeline_artifact (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snapshot (
	reference VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR, 
	source_id VARCHAR, 
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	published_at VARCHAR, 
	scope TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (reference), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES etl_execucao (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES fonte_dado (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicle_spec (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR, 
	model VARCHAR, 
	trim VARCHAR, 
	powertrain VARCHAR, 
	country_market VARCHAR, 
	vehicle_category VARCHAR, 
	model_year_start INTEGER, 
	model_year_end INTEGER, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS battery_asset (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	battery_model_id VARCHAR, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	parent_battery_id VARCHAR, 
	passport_identifier VARCHAR, 
	manufacturer_serial_number VARCHAR, 
	manufacturing_date VARCHAR, 
	first_service_date VARCHAR, 
	current_status VARCHAR, 
	confidence VARCHAR, 
	last_observed_at VARCHAR, 
	battery_identifier_type VARCHAR, 
	battery_identifier VARCHAR, 
	passport_schema VARCHAR, 
	passport_version VARCHAR, 
	passport_url_reference VARCHAR, 
	passport_issuer VARCHAR, 
	passport_created_at VARCHAR, 
	passport_last_updated VARCHAR, 
	soh_percent FLOAT, 
	soce_percent FLOAT, 
	energy_throughput_kwh FLOAT, 
	last_known_temperature FLOAT, 
	last_known_soc FLOAT, 
	cycle_count INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (passport_identifier), 
	FOREIGN KEY(battery_model_id) REFERENCES battery_model (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_battery_id) REFERENCES battery_asset (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fleet_active_publication (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	publication_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(publication_id) REFERENCES fleet_publication (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fleet_model_group (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	publication_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model_key VARCHAR, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR, 
	model VARCHAR, 
	vehicle_category VARCHAR, 
	powertrain_type VARCHAR, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (publication_id, model_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(publication_id) REFERENCES fleet_publication (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS frota_snapshot (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	location_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	raw_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	brand VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_year INTEGER, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	propulsion VARCHAR, 
	battery_id VARCHAR, 
	confidence VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	match_method VARCHAR, 
	source_id VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (reference, location_id, raw_name, vehicle_year), 
	CHECK (quantity >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reference) REFERENCES snapshot (reference), 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES localidade (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(battery_id) REFERENCES bateria (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES fonte_dado (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS passport_dossier_revision (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	dossier_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	schema_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	values JSON NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (dossier_id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(dossier_id) REFERENCES passport_dossier (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_classification (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	content_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	rules_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	rules_snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	transformation_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	recognized_quantity BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	pending_quantity BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (content_id, rules_version, transformation_version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(content_id) REFERENCES pipeline_content (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_generation_block (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	publication_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	block_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	completed_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (publication_id, block_index), 
	FOREIGN KEY(publication_id) REFERENCES fleet_publication (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_publication_alert (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	publication_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	policy_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	details JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(publication_id) REFERENCES fleet_publication (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(policy_id) REFERENCES registry_alert_policy (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_publication_state (
	publication_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	block_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (publication_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(publication_id) REFERENCES fleet_publication (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicle_aggregate_observation (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_spec_id VARCHAR, 
	battery_model_id VARCHAR, 
	reference_period VARCHAR, 
	country VARCHAR, 
	state VARCHAR, 
	municipality VARCHAR, 
	vehicle_category VARCHAR, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR, 
	model VARCHAR, 
	trim VARCHAR, 
	powertrain_type VARCHAR, 
	fuel_type VARCHAR, 
	source_record_reference VARCHAR, 
	confidence VARCHAR, 
	model_year INTEGER, 
	manufacture_year INTEGER, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	abve_electrified_classification INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (quantity >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (source_snapshot_id, source_record_reference), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_spec_id) REFERENCES vehicle_spec (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(battery_model_id) REFERENCES battery_model (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicle_spec_battery_compatibility (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_spec_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	battery_model_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	valid_from VARCHAR, 
	valid_to VARCHAR, 
	confidence VARCHAR, 
	evidence_type VARCHAR, 
	verified_by VARCHAR, 
	verified_at VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_spec_id) REFERENCES vehicle_spec (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(battery_model_id) REFERENCES battery_model (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS battery_lifecycle_observation (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	battery_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	observed_at VARCHAR, 
	event_type VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	current_status VARCHAR, 
	soh_percent FLOAT, 
	soce_percent FLOAT, 
	soc_percent FLOAT, 
	odometer_km FLOAT, 
	energy_throughput_kwh FLOAT, 
	temperature_c FLOAT, 
	cycle_count INTEGER, 
	fast_charge_count INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(battery_id) REFERENCES battery_asset (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS battery_passport_record (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	battery_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	values JSON NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (battery_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(battery_id) REFERENCES battery_asset (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_alert_evaluation (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	classification_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	policy_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	previous_source_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	metrics JSON NOT NULL, 
	alerts JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (classification_id, policy_id, previous_source_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(classification_id) REFERENCES pipeline_classification (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(policy_id) REFERENCES pipeline_alert_policy (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_classified_name (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	classification_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	raw_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR, 
	model VARCHAR, 
	powertrain VARCHAR, 
	category VARCHAR, 
	evidence TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (classification_id, raw_name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(classification_id) REFERENCES pipeline_classification (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_publication_group (
	group_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (group_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES fleet_model_group (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(model_id) REFERENCES registry_model (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicle_asset (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vin VARCHAR, 
	renavam VARCHAR, 
	plate VARCHAR, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR, 
	model VARCHAR, 
	trim VARCHAR, 
	vehicle_category VARCHAR, 
	powertrain_type VARCHAR, 
	registration_date VARCHAR, 
	state VARCHAR, 
	municipality VARCHAR, 
	operator VARCHAR, 
	identity_status VARCHAR, 
	identity_confidence VARCHAR, 
	first_seen_at VARCHAR, 
	last_seen_at VARCHAR, 
	model_year INTEGER, 
	manufacture_year INTEGER, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	aggregate_id VARCHAR, 
	vehicle_spec_id VARCHAR, 
	slot_number INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (vin), 
	UNIQUE (renavam), 
	UNIQUE (plate), 
	UNIQUE (aggregate_id, slot_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(aggregate_id) REFERENCES vehicle_aggregate_observation (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_spec_id) REFERENCES vehicle_spec (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fleet_unit_membership (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	publication_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model_group_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	public_identifier VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (publication_id, model_group_id, sequence), 
	UNIQUE (publication_id, vehicle_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(publication_id) REFERENCES fleet_publication (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(model_group_id) REFERENCES fleet_model_group (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicle_asset (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_vehicle (
	vehicle_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	origin_model_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	current_model_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	public_code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	visible BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_publication_id VARCHAR, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (vehicle_id), 
	UNIQUE (origin_model_id, sequence), 
	CHECK (sequence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicle_asset (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(origin_model_id) REFERENCES registry_model (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(current_model_id) REFERENCES registry_model (id), 
	UNIQUE (public_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_publication_id) REFERENCES fleet_publication (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicle_battery_installation (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	battery_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	installed_at VARCHAR, 
	removed_at VARCHAR, 
	installation_type VARCHAR, 
	confidence VARCHAR, 
	position VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicle_asset (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(battery_id) REFERENCES battery_asset (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_current_installation (
	battery_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,

	powertrain_type VARCHAR, 
	registration_date VARCHAR, 
	state VARCHAR, 
	municipality VARCHAR, 
	operator VARCHAR, 
	identity_status VARCHAR, 
	identity_confidence VARCHAR, 
	first_seen_at VARCHAR, 
	last_seen_at VARCHAR, 
	model_year INTEGER, 
	manufacture_year INTEGER, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	aggregate_id VARCHAR, 
	vehicle_spec_id VARCHAR, 
	slot_number INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (vin), 
	UNIQUE (renavam), 
	UNIQUE (plate), 
	UNIQUE (aggregate_id, slot_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(aggregate_id) REFERENCES vehicle_aggregate_observation (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_spec_id) REFERENCES vehicle_spec (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fleet_unit_membership (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	publication_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model_group_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	public_identifier VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (publication_id, model_group_id, sequence), 
	UNIQUE (publication_id, vehicle_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(publication_id) REFERENCES fleet_publication (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(model_group_id) REFERENCES fleet_model_group (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicle_asset (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_vehicle (
	vehicle_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	origin_model_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	current_model_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	public_code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	visible BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_publication_id VARCHAR, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (vehicle_id), 
	UNIQUE (origin_model_id, sequence), 
	CHECK (sequence > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicle_asset (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(origin_model_id) REFERENCES registry_model (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(current_model_id) REFERENCES registry_model (id), 
	UNIQUE (public_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_publication_id) REFERENCES fleet_publication (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicle_battery_installation (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	battery_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	installed_at VARCHAR, 
	removed_at VARCHAR, 
	installation_type VARCHAR, 
	confidence VARCHAR, 
	position VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicle_asset (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(battery_id) REFERENCES battery_asset (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES source_snapshot (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_current_installation (
	battery_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	installation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (battery_id), 
	UNIQUE (vehicle_id, position), 
	FOREIGN KEY(battery_id) REFERENCES battery_asset (id), 
	UNIQUE (installation_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(installation_id) REFERENCES vehicle_battery_installation (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicle_asset (id)
)


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS registry_installation_evidence (
	installation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	observed_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	evidence VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	removal_observed_at VARCHAR, 
	removal_evidence VARCHAR, 
	closed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (installation_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(installation_id) REFERENCES vehicle_battery_installation (id)
)
